name: How should I prepare my kitchen before cabinet replacement starts?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my kitchen before cabinet replacement starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before installers arrive, empty all items from your current cabinets, drawers, and countertops. Pack dishes, pantry staples, and small appliances into labeled boxes and store them safely outside the work area. Clear a direct, unobstructed walking path from the entry door to the kitchen so our crew can safely carry heavy cabinet boxes. Setting up a temporary kitchen station in another room with an electric kettle, microwave, and basic essentials will help you manage daily meals comfortably during installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Empty all cabinets, drawers, and countertops completely, clear a path from your home entrance, and set up a temporary cooking station in an adjacent room.
